industry_analysis.social: Social media fitness influencers and communities. Esports and competitive gaming explosive growth. Outdoor recreation boom post-pandemic. Inclusivity and accessibility in sports and fitness.
industry_analysis.environment: Sustainable materials (recycled ocean plastics, bio-based). Leave No Trace principles for outdoor activities. Carbon-neutral sporting events and products. Water conservation in golf and snow-making.
industry_analysis.opportunity: Home fitness and connected equipment. Outdoor recreation participation growth. Esports equipment and peripherals. Sustainable sports products. Emerging market sports participation and infrastructure.
